summary: Advance your understanding of Treasury Management and ALCO through our specialized training. Prepare to lead in asset-liability management.
lede: Treasury Management & ALCO Training develops the skills to coordinate an institution’s balance sheet for stronger solvency, liquidity, and long-term profitability. You will learn to manage interest rate, currency, and liquidity risks while using structured analysis to support net interest margin and capital decisions. The course covers liquidity risk quantification, interest rate sensitivity, funds transfer pricing, capital allocation, regulatory reporting, and stress testing. You will also practise applying IRRBB and Earnings at Risk concepts, modelling non-maturity deposits, and creating more proactive, data-driven ALCO decision processes.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced financial professionals responsible for the strategic and operational management of institutional balance sheets.
modules: Liquidity Risk Measurement and Basel III
Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in banking, corporate finance, or risk management. A working knowledge of basic financial accounting and Excel-based modeling is required. Familiarity with the Basel III framework is recommended but not mandatory.
